value.rationale: The first triangle-column open strip has degree-four interior ties unlike the two-row cubic ladder. Computing all Fix(F_n) and Fix(F_n^2) populations resolves a motivated finite-state dynamics problem on a natural bounded-width graph family. Its ninth-order rational zeta and quartic entropy base 3.778651974588 distinguish genuine oscillations from fixed states growing at base three, an effect not implied by general convergence; a complete all-length invariant is provided rather than isolated small cases.
